mapper.select: SELECT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.abs_flag ,bond.issuer_code ,bond.issuer AS issuer_name ,bond.maturity_date ,bond.market FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' WHERE (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs') AND bond.security_status != 'D'

SELECT relation.s_info_windcode AS abs_code ,relation.s_info_compcode AS company_code FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer relation WHERE relation.s_info_typecode IN (115004000, 115203000, 115200000, 115201000)

SELECT status.target_pool_id AS pool_id ,status.security_code FROM ip_pool_status status INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = status.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'company' WHERE status.audit_status = '20' AND status.is_deleted = 0

SELECT status.target_pool_id AS pool_id ,status.security_code FROM ip_pool_status status INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo bond ON bond.wind_code = status.security_code WHERE status.audit_status = '20' AND status.is_deleted = 0 AND (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
